purpose: Dated accepted-release pins and external promotion authority; a source checkout does not certify deployment

currentRuntime.identityRule: Read authenticated runtime health and deployed frontend identity; match source head/tree, build/archive, contract and snapshot to the immutable release evidence packet.
currentRuntime.acceptanceRule: Use the dated clean-browser/API/MCP/model/map/lead/access and privacy receipts for that exact runtime identity. A successful health response alone is not full acceptance.
currentRuntime.sourceCheckoutRule: Final source commits and runtime acceptance are bound by a source-independent external receipt supplied with the final access package. Never guess a final head/build or rewrite source to contain its own identity.

dataProfile.meaning: Exact loaded identities must be read from current runtime and release receipts; a redeploy is not source refresh.
dataProfile.freeSourceClosure: Completed finite lawful free-source route; no qualified current-active/long-open cohort established. Reviewed v8/0.5.0 unchanged. No paid source is required, purchased or needed for reproduction. Unsearched paid full history remains unknown.

currentAccountObservation.meaning: Dated read-only observation, not a final invoice or permanent availability

strictAgeExample.meaning: Historical accepted strict positive. Compare the final current-runtime rehearsal receipt; do not convert unknown-age matches into strict age positives.

publicationBoundary: Historical CID1/CID2 public identity; current retained run04 and bounded CLI/Atlas outputs local-only. New public/Atlas/IPNS/on-chain/registry effects require separate authorization and verified receipts.
submissionBoundary: Qualifying PR, playable media and Ready transition are separate externally authorized gates; a source checkout or test pass is not official submission.

acceptedRelease.meaning: Accepted scoped runtime/access baseline, not a claim that every original positive-source outcome is met or a later documentation commit is already deployed.

releaseAssemblyAuthority.finalPromotionRule: The external final release receipt, not a predicted source field here, binds final head/tree, archive, frontend, contract, snapshots, deployment time, first-use checks, retention and access headroom.

availability.retentionRule: At least fourteen days after final release or employer acknowledgment, whichever is later; actual retained-through date and finite dependency renewals are recorded in the external final access receipt.
availability.qualification: The accepted map expiry is not an automatic fourteen-day extension for a subsequent release.

usageLimits.remainingRule: Use dated durable-ledger readback from the final receipt, not static source values.
